chunks: 5634 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who left his maternal brother and did not leave any heir other than him. He said: “The estate belongs to him.”
I said: “What if there is a grandfather along with the maternal brother?” He said: “The maternal brother is given one-sixth, and the grandfather is given the remainder.”

key_terms.أَخَاهُ لِأُمِّهِ: maternal brother, meaning a brother related through the mother
key_terms.الْبَاقِيَ: the remainder left after the fixed share is given
key_terms.وَارِثًا: an inheritor entitled to receive from the estate

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a maternal brother when a grandfather is also present?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance shares in two cases involving a maternal brother. If the deceased leaves only a maternal brother, he receives the whole estate; if a grandfather is also present, the maternal brother receives one-sixth and the grandfather takes the remainder.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5634 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who passed away leaving only his maternal brother as an heir and no other inheritor.
Imam (as) said: "The entire estate belongs to him."

I then asked: "What if there is also a grandfather along with the maternal brother?"
Imam (as) replied: "The maternal brother is given one-sixth, and the grandfather receives the remainder."
